summary: Single-select alignment group, a required text filter and a multi-select formatting group.
use: Editor toolbars with exclusive options like alignment and combinable options like bold or italic.
spec: Alignment items: AlignLeft, AlignCenter, AlignRight with `'aria-label': 'Align left'` etc.
Filter: `type="single"` with `required`, `aria-label="Filter"`, `bind:value={filter}` (starts `'all'`), items All, Open, Closed; pressing the active item keeps it
`format` is `$state<string[]>(['bold'])` with items Bold, Italic, Underline
